name: Lily Rakness Parra
prior_offices: Washakie County clerk (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Lily Rakness Parra is the Washakie County clerk and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official 2026 general election results list her as the winner of the clerk race.
